title: Sauce Gardner exhibits ‘no excuses’ mentality as Colts defense denies offense inside red zone

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sauce Gardner exhibits ‘no excuses’ mentality as Colts defense denies offense inside red zone
sources.description: Last season, Gardner allowed just 22 completions on 45 targets (49%), which was the tenth-lowest completion rate among qualified cornerbacks.
